args.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name IN ('sensor_logs','shared_export');
SELECT log_id, device_id, event, recorded_at, notes FROM sensor_logs WHERE recorded_at >= '2026-09-01' AND recorded_at < '2026-10-01' ORDER BY recorded_at;
SELECT export_id FROM shared_export WHERE export_id='EXP-202609-01';
